test_title: SSC CPO 2024 Official Paper-I (Held On: 27 Jun, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

Last night, I failed to sleep because of some __familiar issues that couldn’t be avoided.__
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the given sentence, the word 'inevitable' is the most appropriate choice.
 
• The word **'inevitable'** means **unavoidable**, which fits the context of the sentence better than the other options.
 
• The other options do not convey the same meaning. For example:
 
 
• **Unthinkable:** Not capable of being imagined or grasped mentally.
 
• **Unsolvable:** Not able to be solved.
 
• **Incapable:** Not having the ability, qualification, or strength to perform a specified act or function.
 
 

Hence, the correct sentence is **"*Last night, I failed to sleep because of some familiar issues that were inevitable"***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Understanding the context of a sentence is crucial in selecting the most appropriate word.
 
• It's important to consider the exact meaning and nuance of each word option.
